source.reference: GenshinHub original Main DPS synthesis from Genshin-Builds v7.2 structured build/team data, GameWith role cross-check, and genshin-db 5.2.15 mechanics; no external tier or editorial rank imported

teams.name: Mitya Stellar-Conduct Team
teams.description: VERIFIED REFERENCE LINEUP. Mitya is the on-field Main DPS; Odette supports Stellar-Conduct reaction conversion and buffs; Sucrose provides VV resistance reduction and EM sharing; Valeriy shields and supports Electro damage. All four slots assume C0 or lower. Party-triggered Superconduct must be converted to Stellar-Conduct; Mitya holds Skill to enter Overloaded State and spends Gradient Beacons with his special Charged Attack. Artifact overlap checked: Odette carries Heart of the Furnace, Sucrose carries Viridescent Venerer, Valeriy carries Gladiator's Finale + Shimenawa's Reminiscence, so Mitya uses Gilded Dreams / Disenchantment in Deep Shadow without competing for a unique support set.

teams.name: Stellar-Conduct Synergy Team
teams.description: VERIFIED REFERENCE LINEUP. Mitya is the on-field Main DPS; Odette supplies Cryo and Stellar-Conduct support; Yae Miko supplies off-field Electro damage and particles; Valeriy shields and supports Electro damage. All four slots assume C0 or lower. Party-triggered Superconduct must be converted to Stellar-Conduct; extra Electro particles reduce Mitya's ER need, so ER remains a substat rather than a main stat. Artifact overlap checked: Odette carries Heart of the Furnace, Yae Miko carries Disenchantment in Deep Shadow, Valeriy carries Gladiator's Finale + Shimenawa's Reminiscence, so Mitya's listed Personal-DPS sets remain available.
